summary: 1933 L-4 ground cabin on Lightning Peak, Payette National Forest, Valley County, Idaho; destroyed 1960 or 1963 (sources differ); no source describes what remains.

facts.design: L-4 cab, described as a 14 x 14 ground cabin
facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1960 or 1963 (sources differ); no source describes what, if anything, remains at the site

events.note: L-4 cab erected; Forest Lookouts describes a 14 x 14 ground cabin
University of Idaho photo captioned Old Lightning Peak Lookout, photo text Aug. 1957
Firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts give 1960; Forest Lookouts, citing Kresek, gives 1963

notes_for_editor: Destroyed year conflicts: 1960 (firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts) vs 1963 (Forest Lookouts, citing Kresek). Recorded 1960 with the variant in the note; a human should check Kresek's text. The archive caption places a lookout on the peak in 1957 but does not establish which cab it was. No staffing sources found. The record's existing photo is the same archive image; the archive rights statement reads In Copyright - Educational Use Permitted, so it is not free to reuse. Record had no events; design and events added.
